digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and route registry foundation
propositions: Define a stdlib-only factory protocol (build_parser) and immutable route registry that can locate parsers and describe routes without importing handlers or optional dependencies
Rebar ArgumentParser customization must produce deterministic help formatting (fixed width, UTF-8 LF, trailing newline) and compatibility-shaped parse errors without defining new grammar
Route records validate duplicate spellings, alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, and malformed references without resolving handlers
Legacy policy-set exports must derive from routes and maintain shadow-parity with all current command sets and arms
Registry construction and route lookup must not import handlers (pydantic_ai, rebar_reconciler) or optional packages; import isolation verified via subprocess isolation in tests
No runtime help or execution paths cut over; existing behavior remains authoritative and rollback is removal-only
